what_it_is: One frozen training batch, the weights it was taken at, the per-parameter float64 step-1 gradient with its presence pattern, and every random draw the step made. This is the artifact PROTOCOL instrument A is measured against.

canonical_location.why: qb2 has 3.0 TB free and is the host of3t-gradients runs on, so consumer and data are co-located. pc is at 97 % and git carries no .pt.

upstream.note: Reference stack targets 0.5.0 per LEDGER R1-AMENDED. tt-bio's production pin stays 0.4.3 (0bb17be5199846e806b6347b6e17c6249c88ff1b).

batch.composition: one protein chain, one Fe ligand, one Na ligand
batch.why_this_one: smallest entry in the corpus on which all eleven loss terms are non-zero

finite_difference_validation.method: float64 central differences on the same forward, h = 1e-5, RNG pinned per evaluation
finite_difference_validation.sampling_rule: entries with |analytic| >= 1e-6, because 99.9 % of individual entries are exactly zero on a padded 56-token batch

artifacts.what: the frozen batch, already collated by their openfold_batch_collator
recycle count, diffusion noise levels, every torch.randn draw, every random.random draw, and the full RNG state including OpenFold3.synced_generator
per parameter, whether it had a gradient at all. None must match None; never fill with zeros.

the run's own record from bundle_min.py, including every finite-difference check. Renamed from manifest.json so it cannot be mistaken for this publication on a case-sensitive filesystem; it carries the same hold notice.
per-parameter gradient, float64, None preserved. Produced and verified on the rented A100; the copy to qb2 was interrupted and is re-running.
the float64 weights the gradient was taken at. Values are exactly float32-representable: the model is initialised in float32 and cast up, so a float32 copy is lossless.

how_to_regenerate.command: PYTHONPATH=<openfold-3 v0.5.0 checkout> python bundle_min.py --batch <batch> --batch-sha256 <sha> --out <dir> --dtype float64 --fd-samples 16
how_to_regenerate.warning: Regeneration reproduces the bundle only within one environment. Rebuilding the batches twice on the same box gives 20/20 byte-identical files; rebuilding on a different machine from the same seed, corpus and config gives 0/20, while producing the identical entry order and token counts. Fetch the bytes and check the sha256.

consumer_rules: Match the draws before comparing anything. The recycle count is drawn per step from U{0..3} and the diffusion head noises 48 structures; two stacks that drew differently are comparing different work.
The recycle draw comes from OpenFold3.synced_generator, a private np.random.default_rng held as a model attribute (model.py:77). torch.manual_seed does not reach it.
None is not zero. Compare the presence pattern as a set before any magnitude.
The gradient is BEFORE clipping. At world size 1 with accumulate_grad_batches 1 the optimizer-facing gradient is exactly grad * clip_coef.
status: GRADIENT ARTIFACT ON HOLD, cause found and fix demonstrated. At a random init OF3 zero-initialises 2271 of 4890 weight tensors, so a step-1 gradient reaches only the 6 zero-initialised output projections. Re-issued with of3-p2-155k.pt loaded it reaches 4140 of 4147. The trained-weights gradient is measured but its finite-difference validation is not yet passing at h=1e-5 (median rel 0.353), so it is not published for instrument A yet.

determinism_floor.method: two processes, same seed, same batch, same box, float64
determinism_floor.note: file sha256 differs between two runs that agree to 1.9e-16, so a file-hash comparison is the wrong instrument; the hashes here verify a transfer, not a computation

hold_investigation.conclusion: float64 mode ruled out: the same script at --dtype float32, with no autocast or .float() patching active, gives 6 of 4147 as well. The cause is the direct call, not the precision mode.
hold_investigation.their_runner_contrast: 4850 of 4890 state-dict tensors moved over the 20-step fp32 trajectory driven through OpenFold3AllAtom and pl.Trainer.

reading_order: MANIFEST.json is the publication. run_record.json is one invocation of bundle_min.py. If they ever disagree, MANIFEST.json wins.

ruled_out: float64 mode (fp32 direct call also gives 6)
the direct call (their OpenFold3AllAtom + pl.Trainer also gives 6)
the batch (4hhb at the full 384-token crop also gives 6)
root_cause.trajectory_evidence: tensors moved per step: 0 at k=1 (lr=0), 7 at k=2, 1702 at k=3, 3567 at k=4, 4267 at k=5, 4850 of 4890 at k=20 - the zero gates open one layer at a time
root_cause.campaign_consequence: instrument A must not be performed on a step-1 gradient from a random init: 4141 of 4147 per-tensor comparisons would be zero against zero, and the gate would pass with our trunk deleted

fd_at_h_1e-5.interpretation: truncation, not a wrong gradient: O(h^2 L''') on a curved trained surface, with samples now deep in the trunk. h-sweep 1e-3..1e-7 running.
